about: Dev-only fixture vaults, served when NEXT_PUBLIC_VAULTS_SAMPLE=1 in development. Each entry holds the UI metadata, the vault, its cycles and exposure in the HTTP API shapes (amounts are base-unit strings, newest cycle first) and the wallet position with its vault history (newest first). Timestamps were written against `anchor` and are shifted to the current time when loaded.
